name: (Melfesh Monster) Torrential Advance

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: The Melfesh Monster dissolves into a mass of fungal threads and surges forward. It Tramples (Medium or smaller, limb, DC 21 basic Reflex save save), leaving a spore cloud in the squares through which it moves that last until the end of its next turn. A creature that enters or begins its turn in the cloud inhales spores and must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save save or be Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). This ability replaces Envelop and Spore Cloud.
